questions.question: How does Isaiah 40 open?
options: 'How long, O LORD, will you forget me?'
'Hear, O heavens above, and give ear, O earth'
'Comfort, comfort my people, says your God'
questions.answer: 'Comfort, comfort my people, says your God'

questions.question: What famous promise about waiting on the LORD appears in Isaiah 40?
options: They shall renew their strength and mount up with wings like eagles
They shall shine like the stars of heaven for ever and ever
They shall lie down in green pastures and find rest for their souls
They shall be gathered like sheaves into the great storehouse of God
questions.answer: They shall renew their strength and mount up with wings like eagles

questions.question: Isaiah 40 says the grass withers and the flower fades, but the word of our God stands forever.
A voice cries: 'In the wilderness prepare the way of the LORD; make straight in the desert a _____ for our God.'
They who wait for the LORD shall renew their strength; they shall mount up with wings like _____.
